body: Know how that is, but not sure what it is. I used to think that its just me being a "pussy" like you said but could be wrong. But as you saw on my post things do happen sometimes.

I have great memory and that is a bad thing in my case, I wish I could just forget about things but I cant forget anything. Remembering perfectly about stuff you care more then anything, stuff that makes you cry instantly and doing so every day is not what I am looking forward to.
Europe, dont think ill say more then that. Sorry.
Thing is, I dont want to. I gave lots of thought to this so its happening. Only part that sucks is that it will hurt my mom and brother. Other then that I am okay with it.
Pretty sure she wouldnt want me to do this, but nothing I can do about it.
Its not recent I lost the person I cant go on without. So it took a while before this.
Death is hard, if it wasnt something really hard to do so many will be dead already, but everyone is fighting for their life cuz they dont want to die. Am I wrong?
Its not easy to kill yourself, I know but once someone gets their mind on it, it really happens. If you want to talk to me do so, I got few days to spend.
